outcome: appropriateness of blood and blood product use
cohort: The study included 330 obstetric in-patients for whom blood crossmatch requests were made at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Of 330 obstetric in-patients, 60.6% (n=200) received blood transfusions, with anaemia being the most common reason (51.5%), and 29% of the transfused units were deemed unnecessary.
mod_finding: 39 units of red cells were used across 86 instances of Caesarean sections, resulting in a crossmatch-to-transfusion ratio of 1.65.
cross-section timing: Data was collected over a period of 1.5 years.
